title: What a burdock burr taught George de Mestral about fastening things

posts.facebook:
A dog, a burdock burr, a microscope and years of trial weaving in France.

How George de Mestral got the idea for Velcro from burdock burrs, how he and a weaver in France made it work, why it flopped with fashion and found its first fans in spaceflight, and where the four accounts we read disagree about the trip and the patent date.

Noticing is half of inventing; the other half is the years it takes to make the thing you noticed.
